verdict.rationale: Box ships a documented first-party Box AI API to ask questions of, summarize, and extract metadata from stored files. The guide covers request handling, input limits, and agent configuration. Changelog entries for new models and model overrides, a visual agent configurator, and documented Extract-to-metadata and Hub Q&A workflows show the surface is shipped, not just announced. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that ask, summarize and extract work as documented.
